subject: literacy
concept: Reading a longer passage and answering a mix of literal and inferential comprehension questions
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading comprehension sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while reading a longer passage
exercise.abstract: Student reads a full passage and answers a mix of literal ('what happened') and inferential ('why do you think') questions

assessment.mastery_threshold: 4/5 correct across both literal and inferential questions
misconception_flags: answers literal questions well but cannot make any inference beyond the text

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
